_table_naming_note: Table name is ef_csv_<filename>, extension dropped and non-alphanumeric folded to underscore. 'Dataset1.csv' therefore resolves to 'ef_csv_dataset1'. Set table_name_override to bypass that - also the way to land several matched files in one shared table.
_table_schema_note: The full table shape: the source columns from source_config.json followed by the ingestion metadata. Checked against the DataFrame before every write, so a drift between the two configs fails the run instead of silently producing a differently-shaped table. Set to null to skip the check and derive the shape from the source instead.
_write_mode_note: append (default), or overwrite for a full replace each run.
_partition_note: Empty is right for a table this small. Partitioning under roughly a few GB costs more than it saves.
